# Hilly Mascot Assets Directory

Place your Hilly mascot image assets in this directory (`/public/mascots/`).

### Recommended Naming Conventions:
- **Front View**: `hilly-front.png` or `hilly-standing.png`
- **Back View**: `hilly-back.png`
- **Emotions / Poses**:
  - `hilly-waving.png`
  - `hilly-pointing.png`
  - `hilly-reading_map.png`
  - `hilly-drinking_tea.png`
  - `hilly-thinking.png`
  - `hilly-celebrating.png`
  - `hilly-happy.png`
  - `hilly-excited.png`
  - `hilly-confused.png`

Any `.png`, `.webp`, `.jpg`, or `.svg` files placed in this folder will be automatically accessible at `/mascots/<filename>`.
